## ELECTRIC RELIABILITY COUNCIL OF TEXAS, INC.’S UPDATE REGARDING A TIMELINE FOR RELIABILITY-MUST RUN AND MUST- RUN ALTERNATIVE ACTIVITIES

Electric Reliability Council of Texas, Inc. (ERCOT) provides this update regarding the timeline for potentially entering into one or more agreements for Reliability Must-Run (RMR) or Must-Run Alternative (MRA) service as a result of CPS Energy's planned retirement of three Generation Resources: BRAUNIG_VHB 1, BRAUNIG_VHB2, and BRAUNIG_VHB3 (hereinafter, “the Braunig Resources”) on March 31, 2025.

On April 23, 2024, ERCOT filed with the Public Utility Commission of Texas (the Commission) a notice that ERCOT had conducted its reliability analysis of whether the Braunig Resources would be needed to support ERCOT System reliability.<sup>1</sup> This reliability analysis was required under subsection (e) of the Commission’s rule, 16 Texas Administrative Code (TAC) § 25.502, and ERCOT Protocols § 3.14.1.2 after CPS Energy submitted to ERCOT Notices of Suspension of Operation (NSOs) of the Braunig Resources. This reliability analysis identified ERCOT System performance deficiencies that are materially impacted by the retirement of the Braunig Resources; therefore, the Braunig Resources are needed to support ERCOT System reliability.

In the same April 23, 2024 filing, ERCOT requested from the Commission a good cause exception to permit ERCOT to deviate from the deadlines in the ERCOT Protocols for the RMR-and MRA-related activities that must be conducted when a Resource Entity proposes to retire a Generation Resource that ERCOT has determined is needed for reliability. On May 2, 2024, the Commission issued an order granting ERCOT a limited good cause exception to permit variance from the deadlines in the ERCOT Protocols for the RMR and MRA processes associated with the proposed suspension of the Braunig Resources, including the deadlines in ERCOT Protocols <sup>1</sup>

<sup>1</sup> See PUC Project No. 55999, Item No. 30, Electric Reliability Council of Texas, Inc.’s Notice of Reliability Analysis Determination and Request for Good Cause Exception (Apr. 23, 2024).
